manifest.description: Original and previous are recovered from Git; current is built from lib/

method: 5 paired alternating trials per build. Each trial uses a fresh visible page with a 1000x560 scene at DPR 2 and mapScale 2. Idle rAF calibration precedes each workload; the first median calibration is the missed-slot reference for all trials. Each trial warms for 1000 ms and samples rAF intervals for 4000 ms. Update work is synchronous JS/canvas/encoding/driver-submission time, excluding asynchronous decode and GPU completion. Animation FPS describes browser rAF cadence rather than physical frame presentation. Shared-host noise, compositor scheduling and display cadence can affect samples.
retainedData: All 50 trial aggregates retained; per-frame and idle interval arrays omitted. Full traces can be regenerated with the runner.
